# Full catalog (version 2.4.3)

<!-- generated by tools/readme_catalog.py: do not edit by hand -->

Every agent and the whole library of team. To get started read the [README](../README.md); to use, change or create agents the [agent guide](AGENTS.md); details are in the [reference manual](REFERENCE.md). [Versione italiana](CATALOG.it.md).

> [!TIP]
> **How to use an agent from this page:** ask for it by name ("have the tester check it"), or `/team:call-team <task>`. When its pack is off, switch it on first: `/team:agents enable <pack>`. Its full instructions: `/team:agents show <agent>`. A library entry: `/team:library show <entry>`.

- [All agents](#all-agents)
- [The whole library](#the-whole-library)

## All agents

**137 agents**: 20 in the core, 91 in the other packs, 26 in the language packs; the `alt` pack holds alternative versions of existing roles (`alt-<name>`). Switch a pack on with `/team:agents enable <pack>` (the core is always on).

<details><summary><b>core</b> (20)</summary>

| Agent | What it does |
|---|---|
| `accessibility-specialist` | Use this agent to check and improve the accessibility of a user interface against WCAG 2.2 AA. |
| `architect` | Use this agent when a task needs a structural decision before code is written. |
| `backend-dev` | Use this agent to implement or fix server-side, CLI, library, data or infrastructure code once the task is clear. |
| `code-reviewer` | Use this agent to review a change for quality before it is merged. |
| `data-analyst` | Use this agent to study data. |
| `database-engineer` | Use this agent for anything that touches how data is stored. |
| `devops-engineer` | Use this agent for build, delivery and operations. |
| `doc-keeper` | Use this agent to bring the project memory and documentation in line with the code after a change. |
| `e2e-tester` | Use this agent to test complete user flows end to end, in a real browser or through the real interfaces. |
| `frontend-dev` | Use this agent to implement or fix user interface code once the task is clear. |
| `market-researcher` | Use this agent to research a market with sources. |
| `marketing-strategist` | Use this agent to plan and write how a product is presented and promoted. |
| `performance-engineer` | Use this agent when speed, resource use or scale matter. |
| `product-manager` | Use this agent to turn an idea or a request into a clear, testable scope before work starts. |
| `refactor-specialist` | Use this agent to improve the structure of existing code without changing what it does. |
| `release-manager` | Use this agent to take verified work to a merge or a release. |
| `security-reviewer` | Use this agent when a change touches security-sensitive code. |
| `technical-writer` | Use this agent to write or fix the documentation people read. |
| `tester` | Use this agent after code was written or changed, to verify it independently before it is accepted. |

</details>

## The whole library

**533 entries**: 417 skills, 94 commands, 22 rule sets. MIT license (`skills/team/library/NOTICE.md`). Search with `/team:library search <words>`, install with `library enable <id|pack>`.
